76:     # Multiple versions and multiple editions might be installed, so we iterate over versions installed.
77:     # If version preference is given, we filter only matching versions, othervise the highest version is picked.
78:     def has_editions(version: Path) -> bool:
79:         # The version should have at least one known edition installed inside it.
80:         return any(e.name in edition_preferences for e in version.iterdir())
81: 
82:     def matches_version_preference(version: Path) -> bool:
83:         return version_preference is None or version.name == version_preference
